title: kragg policy
description: Settings for kragg, read from kragg.json or from the "kragg" key of package.json. Every key, type and range here is exactly what the loader (src/policy/policy.ts) enforces: a value this schema rejects is one kragg rejects with exit 2, naming the setting. Absent keys take the defaults listed per property.

stringList.description: A list of strings. A bare string is accepted as a one-element list; an empty list is an explicit, honoured empty.

$schema.description: Editor validation pointer, e.g. "./node_modules/kragg/kragg.schema.json". Not a setting.

profile.description: Name of the policy pack, reported in kragg status. Default: "strict-ai-typescript".

source_paths.description: Directories holding first-party source, relative to the project root. Default: ["src"].

test_paths.description: Directories holding tests, relative to the project root. Default: ["test", "tests"].

coverage_fail_under.description: Line-coverage percentage below which the coverage gate fails. 0 means coverage is not asked for. Default: 80.

type_max_nesting_depth.description: Depth above which a type fails the type-complexity gate. Default: 2.

type_max_length.description: Rendered length above which a type must be named. Default: 40.

max_violations_per_gate.description: Cap on violations reported per gate. 0 means no cap. Default: 25.

layers.description: Architectural layers, outermost first, for the boundaries gate; a module may import its own layer or a lower one. Empty means the gate skips visibly. Default: [].

max_file_lines.description: Maximum lines in one source file, comments included, before the structure gate fails. Default: 500.

max_public_symbols.description: Maximum exported symbols in one module before the structure gate fails. Default: 20.

structure_exclude.description: Glob patterns exempt from the structure budgets. Default: [].

mutation_include.description: Glob patterns scoping mutation testing in. Empty means everything. Default: [].

mutation_exclude.description: Glob patterns scoping mutation testing out. Default: [].

forbidden_calls.description: Banned call targets. An object maps each banned call to the hint that says what to use instead; a list bans each entry with no hint. Every hint must be a string — a malformed hint is an error, and the ban is never dropped. {} is an explicit empty ban list. Default: {}.

secret_name_suffixes.description: Identifier suffixes that mark a binding as holding a secret, for the secret-default gate. Default: ["Secret", "Token", "Password", "Passphrase", "ApiKey", "SigningKey", "SecretKey", "PrivateKey", "AccessKey", "ServiceKey"].

lint_tool.description: Which linter the lint gate drives. "auto" detects; "off" skips visibly. Default: "auto".

test_runner.description: Which test runner the coverage gate drives. Default: "auto".

secret_scanner.description: Which secret scanner the detect-secrets gate drives. "auto" detects one and skips visibly if there is none; naming one makes it required, so an unavailable or broken scanner is an error (exit 3). Default: "auto".

secret_baseline.description: Reviewed-findings baseline for the secret scanner, relative to the project root. null means none. Default: null.

audit_severity.description: Advisories below this severity are counted but not reported. Default: "high".

coverage_report_path.description: Where the test runner writes its istanbul JSON, relative to the project root. Default: "coverage/coverage-final.json".
